title: Paid reservations: Proof strip
topics: Greedy choices, dynamic programming and backtracking
summary: Scheduling DP and binary search. Return the whole list.
descriptionMd:
Inputs
`drawers` is a list of bookings. Each row is [start, end, reward].

Your tasks
1. Create a list `bestRewards`. Each row of `drawers` is a booking: [start, end, reward]. It uses time from start up to, but not including, end. A booking may start exactly when another one ends. Sort the bookings by end time, then start time, then reward, all from smallest to largest. Look at the first booking, then the first two bookings, and so on. For each of these groups, choose bookings that do not overlap and give the largest total reward. Record that reward. You may choose no bookings for a reward of 0. With no bookings, `bestRewards` is empty.
2. Complete `paidReservationsProofStrip` so it returns `bestRewards`. Return it, do not print it.

Example
If `drawers` is [[7, 8, 7], [0, 2, 2], [6, 11, 6], [10, 11, 10], [11, 12, 11]], then `bestRewards` is [2, 9, 9, 19, 30] and `paidReservationsProofStrip` returns [2, 9, 9, 19, 30].

Rules
- If `bestRewards` is empty, return [].

Test data
TEST DATA 1: `drawers` is [[-4, 1, 4], [1, 2, 1], [18, 21, 18], [19, 22, 19], [19, 21, 19]].
TEST DATA 2: `drawers` is [[3, 7, 3], [-4, 2, 6], [5, 9, 5], [6, 10, 6]].

referenceSolutions.python:
def paidReservationsProofStrip(drawers):
    a=drawers
    out=[]
    rows=sorted(a,key=lambda r:(r[1],r[0],r[2]))
    dp=[0]
    for i,(start,end,reward) in enumerate(rows):
        left,right=0,i
        while left<right:
            mid=(left+right)//2
            if rows[mid][1]<=start: left=mid+1
            else: right=mid
        dp.append(max(dp[i],dp[left]+reward))
    out=dp[1:]
    return out
